design_rule: Change one primary causal variable per rollout and retain all other feasible invariants from the strongest prior rollout.
promotion_rule: The first checkpoint passing every dev gate is eligible for frozen-test confirmation. Frozen test remains unconsumed before that point.

failed_rollout_cleanup.recoverability: A deleted full-state checkpoint can only be recovered by retraining.

stopping_rule: Stop when one rollout passes the acceptance gate or after rollout 10 completes; then write the final pipeline retrospective.
